Cristiano Ronaldo is bringing his international career to an end after more than 20 years representing Portugal. The 41-year-old made his debut in 2003 and went on to become the country's all-time leading goalscorer and most-capped player. He also played a key role in Portugal's Euro 2016 triumph and their 2019 Nations League victory.
